short_form: Customer may terminate, in whole or in part, any or all Work Orders with or without cause, at any time in its sole discretion, by serving Supplier with a notice of termination. If Customer terminates a Work Order under this provision, then Customer will pay Supplier the reasonable value for Services properly provided prior to the effective date of the termination; provided that if a Work Order is terminated by Customer in response to Supplier's breach of a material obligation, then Customer will be relieved from any obligation to pay Supplier for Services Customer is unable to utilize completely and effectively as a result of Supplier's breach.

long_note: Termination for Convenience / Super Termination Rights
short_form:
Customer may terminate, in whole or in part, any or all Work Orders with or without cause, at any time in its sole discretion, by serving Supplier with a notice of termination. If Customer terminates a Work Order under this provision, then Customer will pay Supplier the reasonable value for Services properly provided prior to the effective date of the termination; provided that if a Work Order is terminated by Customer in response to Supplier's breach of a material obligation, then Customer will be relieved from any obligation to pay Supplier for Services Customer is unable to utilize completely and effectively as a result of Supplier's breach.
In the event that there is any limitation (including a notice period requirement) in the MSA on Customer's right to terminate services (or the agreement as a whole) for convenience, add the following language:
In addition to Customer's right to terminate the Agreement or Services pursuant to Section 2 (Term and Termination) of the Master Agreement, Customer shall have the right to terminate the Agreement and any Work Orders (or part thereof) with immediate effect if Supplier: (i) becomes the subject of any investigation, action or proceeding by any Regulator that is, in Customer's reasonable discretion, likely to have a material adverse effect on the Services or Supplier's ongoing ability to perform the Services; (ii) is in non-compliance with any Applicable Law; (iii) assigns its rights and/or obligations to a third party that provides products or services competitive to products or services offered by the Customer; or (iv) takes any action that, in Customer's reasonable discretion, threatens or is likely to threaten the reputation or goodwill of Customer, whether or not such action is in some way related to the Services performed under the Agreement or Work Order.
